title: TUI relay request: which marked statuses drop out

sections.body:
1. Owner decision 2026-10-17: the drop set stays done and retired; parked, handed-off and in-review marks stay requestable. `Q` notifies naming the dropped ids. A selected unmarked done or retired item follows the same rule. Fix row alignment past 999 rows.
2. Write the tests; watch them go red.
3. Implement; update docs/tui.md and CHANGELOG; mutation-check.
